description: This file contains Python functions related to generating LLVM features based on device configurations and target architectures, particularly for ARM and other architectures. It also includes functions to generate Rust build target specifications with detailed target features and properties. The code is used within a build system (likely Yocto/OpenEmbedded) to automate configuration and code generation tasks for cross-compilation environments.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_tune
methods.description: Extracts LLVM feature flags based on the device's tuning features and machine overrides for ARM architectures.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_cc_arch
methods.description: Generates LLVM feature flags based on the target's compiler architecture features.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_target_fpu
methods.description: Returns a soft float feature flag if the target FPU is set to soft in the configuration.

methods.name: llvm_features
methods.description: Combines various LLVM feature flags into a comma-separated string for the current device configuration.

methods.name: arch_to_rust_target_arch
methods.description: Converts build architecture names to Rust-compatible target architecture strings.

methods.name: llvm_cpu
methods.description: Determines the CPU name string for LLVM based on build variables and features.

methods.name: rust_gen_target
methods.description: Generates a JSON specification for a Rust target based on build variables, architecture, features, and other parameters, and writes it to a file.
